pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregularly polygonal patches with softened, feathered pixel-gradient edges; shapes vary from sub-triangular to heptagonal with spatial density increasing toward the ventral and posterior regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored interstitial pathways; junction nodes are predominantly tri-radial; pixel thickness is relatively uniform across the flank but narrows slightly at the cervical-thoracic junction.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the neck ridge, terminating in a more rounded, lower-profile contour at the shoulder transition.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Several faint, linear vertical striations or superficial textural discontinuities are visible on the lower shoulder and pectoral region, suggestive of healed abrasions.
other_distinctive_markers: A dark avian specimen (Oxpecker) is perched on the mid-lateral neck, creating a distinct localized occlusion and color contrast against the pelage.
